answers.why: The king of Babylon slays the nobles of the kingdom of Judah.
The LORD is called the God of Israel while announcing judgment on the city.
Judah names the population carried captive to Babylon alongside Jerusalem.
Babylon has left a remnant of Judah and appointed Gedaliah over them.
The remnant of Judah is the surviving community threatened with destruction.
The God of Israel receives the supplication of the assembled people.
The God of Israel addresses Judah's remnant about moving to Egypt.
The God of Israel warns the community of judgment like that upon Jerusalem's inhabitants.
The God of Israel announces Nebuchadrezzar's coming to the Judean men in Egypt.
The God of Israel addresses the Jews about the devastation of Jerusalem and Judah's cities.
The God of Israel rebukes the community for evil that threatens its survival.
Men, women, children and infants are threatened with being cut off from Judah.
The God of Israel announces judgment against the disobedient Judean community.
All Judah is threatened with destruction, followed by judgment on its remnant in Egypt.
The God of Israel addresses the people and their wives about their idolatrous vows.
Judah's remnant consists of those who went to Egypt to live there.
